d: Sumeet Industries has announced a rights issue worth nearly ₹200 crore. In this video, we explain the complete rights issue details, including the issue size, rights entitlement ratio, key dates, and how shareholders can participate. We also discuss Sumeet Industries' business model, its integrated polyester manufacturing operations, the acquisition by the Eagle Group, recent financial performance, planned utilization of rights issue proceeds, and the company's upcoming capex plans.
